summary: A promo code shared on X by Mistral AI itself (@MistralAI), not verified by freetokens. The post, dated 2026-11-17, says: “we’re making Vibe free in Europe for the first 3 months.” and “Use code LECHONK via link in 🧵. Limited time, first-come, first-served.” A reply in the same thread says: “Limited offer for developers in Europe: Start with Vibe Pro free for three months with the code LECHONK via link […] Terms apply.” The post gives no end date. Within about 45 minutes, several replies from other users said the code was no longer available; Mistral has not posted an end notice.
claim_steps: Open the redeem link from Mistral’s thread: https://bit.ly/VibeProLimitedOffer (it goes to https://admin.mistral.ai/subscription/upgrade/redeem?redeem_code=LECHONK).
Log in to, or create, your Mistral account when asked.
Use code LECHONK if it is not already filled in. The thread says: “Start with Vibe Pro free for three months with the code LECHONK”.
Who can use it, per the thread: “Limited offer for developers in Europe”. The post adds: “Limited time, first-come, first-served.” and “Terms apply.”
The post gives no end date. Replies from other users within about 45 minutes said the code no longer worked.
